Quick confirmation from the EU engineering side: we’re on Central European Time (CET) now (UTC+1). That means:

- 17:00 CET = 11:00 Eastern (ET) = 08:00 Pacific (PT)
- 19:30 CET = 13:30 ET = 10:30 PT

So Diane’s math is correct — Option A lines up with 08:00 PT. If Ken prefers a slightly later PT slot, Option B maps to 10:30 PT which might be more Pacific-friendly.
